headlines.description: — Jeremiah Smith became Ohio State's career receiving yardage leader, Ja’Kobi Jackson scored twice and the sixth-ranked Buckeyes rolled to a 59-3 victory over Kent State on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith sets Ohio State career receiving mark as 6th-ranked Buckeyes roll past Kent State 59-3
